title: Codex Scientiae JSONL store signature sidecar
description: The .sig written beside a committed JSONL store. Records what the store's bytes were and what produced them, so a hash that fails to reproduce is attributable rather than merely wrong. additionalProperties is false deliberately: an unrecognised field is engine drift, and forcing a version bump is the point.

sha256.description: SHA-256 over the published bytes, accumulated during the write.

line_count.description: Records written, including a header record when the kind emits one.

file_size.description: Byte length of the published .jsonl, from os.stat after the rename.

ticks.description: Published file's last-write time as .NET UTC ticks, integer-derived from st_mtime_ns. Matches the sourceLastWriteUtcTicks field of the JSOI v2 index.

discipline.description: Write discipline declared by the kind that produced this store.

codec.description: Escaping policy in force. The hash covers codec-dependent bytes, so reproducing it requires the same value.

metadata.description: Caller-supplied stage metadata. Free-form by design; this is the extension point, so the rest of the document can stay closed.

created_at.description: When the signature was written. Not a determinism input.
